title: 主窗口 → 菜单/工具栏 → 参数页焦点
scope: A bounded original resource/event/call chain, not the whole menu or all focus paths.
currentImplementationCorrespondence: Not mapped for this bounded chain; this does not prove absence of a current implementation.

edges.behavior: App构造MainWindow；所选XAML的x:Class为VisionMasterMain.MainWindow。仅静态构造/资源对应，原机加载未执行。

<localApp:TitleBar x:Name="m_TitleMy" IsButtonClickEnabled="{Binding IsShowProgressMask, ElementName=MainView, Mode=OneWay, Converter={StaticResource negateConverter}}">
        <UIElement.Effect>
          <DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="5" Direction="270" Opacity="0.40" ShadowDepth="2" Color="#FF0F1010" />
        </UIElement.Effect>
      </localApp:TitleBar>

<Menu Name="menu" WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" Margin="0,3,0,1" Background="#00FFFFFF" Style="{StaticResource NormalMenuStyle}" ItemTemplate="{StaticResource MenueDataTemplate}" FontSize="14" HorizontalAlignment="Left" IsEnabled="{Binding IsButtonClickEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:TitleBar}}" ItemsSource="{Binding MenuSource.Items}">
          <ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
            <Style BasedOn="{StaticResource NormalMenuItemStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type MenuItem}">
              <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Value="True" Binding="{Binding Path=RunData.(VMInterface:IVMRun.IsRunning)}">
                  <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="False" />
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Value="False" Binding="{Binding IsVisible}">
                  <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
                </DataTrigger>
              </Style.Triggers>
              <EventSetter Event="SubmenuOpened" Handler="MenuItem_SubmenuOpened" />
            </Style>
          </ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
        </Menu>
        <Rectangle HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" Height="1" Fill="{DynamicResource Col_Menubar_CentreLine_Fill}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" />

edges.behavior: TitleBar包含TitleToolBar，ItemsSource绑定MenuToolSource；子控件通用按钮样式声明Click EventSetter。

refs.excerpt: <local:TitleToolBar ItemsSource="{Binding MenuToolSource}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsButtonClickEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:TitleBar}}" />

edges.behavior: EventSetter的SubmenuOpened指向MenuItem_SubmenuOpened；处理器体已取得。此边不是ItemClickCommand业务分派。

edges.behavior: 通用按钮样式Click指向Button_Click。特殊自定义模板是否经过此样式不由本边证明。
祖先MainWindow为空则结束，不调用SetFocusedElement。
procedureConfigControl?.curTabControlBase != null才将该参数窗作为focus scope，element作为焦点元素交FocusManager。
参数控件或参数窗不存在则不写焦点。
调用点已知；实际逻辑焦点是否成功、键盘焦点归属、事件路由竞争和样式实际应用未作原机操作验证。

limitations: Each arrow has an explicit relation kind; resource composition is not a method call.
The toolbar branch covers only the shown general button template, not all custom templates.
Source construction/resource declarations are recovered; actual assembly/resource/style activation is not runtime-verified.
No persistence, algorithm execution or native result effect is inferred from this focus-only chain.
